 Advertisement Early shower chance, cooler Tuesday in Omaha area
 Advertisement Updated: 6:08 AM CDT Oct 27, 2026 Editorial Standards ⓘ Sean Everson Meteorologist Early shower chance, cooler Tuesday in Omaha area
 Updated: 6:08 AM CDT Oct 27, 2026 Editorial Standards ⓘ Sean Everson Meteorologist Rain is likely Tuesday morning south and east of the Omaha metro, but still can't rule out a shower in Omaha early on though. Meteorologist Sean Everson has the latest forecast from Omaha's Weather Leader.
 With a combined 50 years covering weather in Nebraska and Iowa, KETV NewsWatch 7 is Omaha’s Weather Leader. Led by Omaha’s Chief Meteorologist Bill Randby , the award-winning team of Sean Everson , Caitlin Harvey , and Ainsley Goebel are focused on alerting you to upcoming severe weather and KETV’s exclusive live radar gives you a 3-minute advantage when storms strike.
